answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn bonding: each agent must burn a protocol relic token to register, and the burn is recorded in a shared atlas of epochs. A challenger can require any agent to mirror its full burn history on-chain; forgery forces re-burning real value, so N fake identities cost N times the relic price. Cheap to verify, expensive to fake. The Agent0064 deployment anchors trust at odNFQex1JW.
